Batumi.title: Batumi
Batumi.seoDescription: Batumi is the capital of Adjara, Georgia's main seaport and a place for a sea holiday.
Batumi.lead: Batumi, the capital of the Autonomous Republic of Adjara, is one of the most beautiful cities in the country.
paragraphs: It was once an ancient Greek colony and a Roman port. The Ottomans attacked it, Georgian kings defended it. Under the Russian Empire the city grew, and today it is Georgia's main seaport and a unique place to rest.

Batumi becomes more beautiful every year. In recent years the city has been developing especially fast. It tries to keep up with the present while keeping its history. Nineteenth-century buildings were restored from archival records. Careful work produced elegant houses with balconies and railings, quiet paved streets and cast facades. Around them you feel the sea breeze and the smell of coffee and citrus.

Batumi has a well-developed tourist infrastructure, which makes it even more attractive for guests. Modern hotels such as Sheraton, Radisson and Hilton stand out from afar with their design. The Georgian government invited builders from around the world to develop the hotel industry here.

Today the centre of Batumi feels like a Western European city: streets with vines, fountains and busy shops. At night the city is brightly lit, and the seaside strip glows. The climate depends on the Black Sea: January is the coldest month, August the hottest. Most visitors come from post-Soviet countries, but in the streets you will also hear English, French and other languages.

In the many restaurants and cafes you can try traditional Georgian food. There are fashion boutiques and a plastic surgery clinic. Among the sights, the world's longest seaside boulevard stands out: it is now about 7 km long. You can rent a bicycle, ride along the boulevard, look at the beach and the monuments.

On the boulevard you will find the Ferris wheel, the Alphabet Tower, a monument to Georgian writing and culture, and other sculptures. Locals call Batumi the city of love, and there are many monuments on this theme. The best known is a man on one knee offering a red heart to a woman.
There is a wedding house that works around the clock, so a marriage can be registered at any time of day. Come to Batumi and enjoy its beauty.
